# 2026 Iowa Secretary of Agriculture election

The 2026 Iowa Secretary of Agriculture election will be held on November 3, 2026, to elect the Secretary of Agriculture of Iowa. Primary elections will be held on June 2. Incumbent Republican secretary Mike Naig is running for re-election.
